traceability_policy.rule: Every important geological or mining value should retain its source, source status and access date where available.
traceability_policy.missing_data_rule: If an official value cannot be verified, MINQORA must show the value as unavailable rather than inventing it.
traceability_policy.conflicting_values_rule: Values from different official/source documents must be retained separately with their respective sources and dates rather than silently overwriting one another.
